title: 合并才几天：流媒体利润率已转正，传统电视风险谁来扛？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Taking another look at Skydance in the after hours, as you can see, a little bit of deterioration here.
segments.zh: 盘后再看Skydance，如你所见，有些走弱。

segments.en: Down about 3%, we are waiting on the call. We did get some details out of earnings that were maybe pleasing to investors.
segments.zh: 下跌约3%，我们在等待电话会。财报中有些细节可能令市场参与者满意。

segments.en: The company deciding it's going to bundle Paramount Plus and HBO Max starting next year, which might give it some pricing power, also reporting a 5% increase in revenue overall.
segments.zh: 公司决定从明年起将Paramount Plus和HBO Max捆绑，这可能带来定价权，整体营收也增长5%。

segments.en: And the court-cutting might be at least moderating if not stopping.
segments.zh: 成本削减可能至少趋于缓和，甚至停止。

segments.en: There was a nice increase in the linear TV portion of things.
segments.zh: 线性电视部分有不错的增长。

segments.en: So let's discuss it all with Ross Gerber, president and CEO of Gerber Kawasaki, wealth and investment management.
segments.zh: 我们请来Gerber Kawasaki总裁兼CEO Ross Gerber讨论，该公司从事财富与资管。

segments.en: So what cheered you out of Skydance's report given that we're really only just a few days into the merger, Ross, and it's hard to know how they're going to proceed?
segments.zh: 合并才几天，很难知道他们将如何推进，Ross，Skydance的报告中什么让你感到鼓舞？

segments.en: Right. Well, I think the most important part is that their streaming business is actually making some decent money and has a positive margin and still is growing.
segments.zh: 对，我认为最重要的是他们的流媒体业务确实赚了些钱，利润率转正，且仍在增长。

segments.en: So streaming is ultimately the future. And so that's a crucial part of Paramount Skydance.
segments.zh: 流媒体最终是未来，所以这是Paramount Skydance的关键部分。

segments.en: I think their traditional business numbers were okay, but I think that's where the biggest risk is as consumers continue to change the way they view,
segments.zh: 我认为他们的传统业务数据还可以，但最大风险在于消费者持续改变观看方式。

segments.en: depending on their age and so many different choices for entertainment.
segments.zh: 取决于他们的年龄和众多娱乐选择。

segments.en: And then, of course, the movie business is a tough business, and they're already telling you they're going to have a bad fourth quarter.
segments.zh: 当然，电影业务艰难，他们已表示第四季度表现不佳。

segments.en: And that's a crucially important part of this business, because it sort of feeds the rest of the ecosystem.
segments.zh: 这是业务的关键部分，因为它支撑整个生态系统。

segments.en: And so that's the nature of the entertainment business.
